purpose: Calibrate and test the offline replay training-free controller
checkpoints: M1 S55 and S151 checkpoints by checked SHA-256
task: generated associative recall; no raw token persistence
calibration_selection: among configurations within 0.02 accuracy and 1.05x selected blocks of fixed-top-k-2, maximize accuracy minus 0.002 times mean blocks; otherwise use the same score without constraints

test_gates.fallback_stress: force uncertainty threshold to zero; dense fallback must run and not reduce accuracy versus fallback disabled
test_gates.pareto_rule: strictly fewer blocks within 0.02 accuracy, or at least 0.005 better accuracy with no more blocks

interpretation: offline two-pass replay evidence only; not an online serving or systems claim
